body.name: Tie-conservative likelihood-level multinomial inversion
body.construction: For \(x\in\mathcal E_{n,K}\), let \(\mu_p(x)=n!\prod_{k=1}^Kp_k^{x_k}/x_k!\), with \(0^0=1\), and set \(C_n=\{p\in\Delta^{K-1}:\sum_{x\in\mathcal E_{n,K}:\mu_p(x)\le\mu_p(N)}\mu_p(x)\ge\alpha\}\). Equivalently, \(C_n\) is the finite union over \(A\subseteq\mathcal E_{n,K}\) of the basic closed semialgebraic sets defined by \(p_k\ge0\), \(\sum_{k=1}^Kp_k=1\), \(\mu_p(x)\le\mu_p(N)\) for every \(x\in A\), and \(\sum_{x\in A}\mu_p(x)\ge\alpha\).
